docs.title: SOC Analyst Lab Portfolio & Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to my cybersecurity lab notebook. This portfolio documents hands-on defensive security simulations, alert triage, threat-hunting scenarios, and log analysis performed across virtual and cloud environments.

docs.title: 🎯 Focus Areas
docs.text:
• Security Operations & Alert Triage: Analyzing endpoint and network telemetry to determine True/False positives.
  • Log Correlation & Detection: Writing and tuning detection queries using SPL and KQL.
  • Threat Hunting & Forensics: Investigating packet captures (PCAPs), process trees, and persistence artifacts.
  • Defensive Frameworks: Mapping adversary tactics directly to the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.

docs.title: 🛠️ Security Tools & Environments
docs.text:
• SIEM / Telemetry: Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Sysmon, Windows Event Logs
  • Traffic Analysis: Wireshark, Zeek
  • Triage & OSINT: VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, Any.Run
  • Core OS: Windows Server, Ubuntu Linux

docs.title: 📂 Featured Case Studies
docs.text: Browse the SOC Labs tab to inspect detailed investigation reports, network topologies, detection queries, and defensive takeaways.

docs.title: Defensive Security & SOC Labs
docs.text: Welcome to my hands-on incident investigation logs. Every lab here documents an alert from initial detection to root-cause analysis and remediation.
